findings.title: Generative AI apps are projected to generate more than $10 billion in consumer spending in 2026
findings.description: Sensor Tower forecasts that downloads of Generative AI apps will reach 7.2 billion in 2026 (+82 % YoY) and in-app purchase revenue will surpass $10 billion.

evidence.quote: Consumers Will Spend More than $10 Billion in Generative AI Apps in 2026 … 7.2 Billion Downloads in 2026 (+82% YoY)

findings.title: Vertical video—led by the Short Drama sub-genre—will overtake traditional OTT streaming app downloads
findings.description: The report predicts that the short-form ‘Short Drama’ format, popularised by TikTok-style vertical video, will drive app growth and is expected to surpass OTT streaming globally on downloads in 2026.

evidence.quote: Vertical Video will Spur App Growth — Led by Short Drama… Short Drama is projected to surpass OTT Streaming globally.

findings.title: Generative AI will rival paid advertising as a driver of website traffic by the end of 2026
findings.description: More than half of the top U.S. websites are expected to receive more traffic from Generative AI than from paid sources, up from 37 % in October 2025.

evidence.quote: By the end of 2026, more than half of top websites will see more traffic from Gen AI than from paid sources.

findings.title: Digital advertisers will shift budget back to image creatives, out-growing video spend in 2026
findings.description: After years of video growth, U.S. digital ad spend on image creatives grew 35 % YoY versus 15 % for video in 2025; the trend is forecast to accelerate as platforms like Meta Reels favour images.

evidence.quote: US digital ad spend on images climbed 35% YoY compared to 15% growth for video creatives… Our 2026 prediction: Ad spend for images will again rise faster than spend on videos.

findings.title: Successful mobile games will combine ad-friendly hooks with deep monetisation to offset rising UA costs
findings.description: With downloads falling toward pre-pandemic levels and user-acquisition costs rising, games that natively advertise well and employ multi-layered monetisation systems are expected to outperform in 2026.

evidence.quote: If the current download trends continue… it [is] more important than ever for mobile games to combine ad-friendly hooks with strong monetization.

findings.title: AI-powered development tools will speed up production cycles and increase the volume of PC game releases
findings.description: 2025 already set a record for new Steam releases; Sensor Tower expects AI tools and accessible engines to continue driving shorter, smarter development cycles and fewer multi-year AAA projects in 2026.

evidence.quote: 2025 has broken the record for most new Steam releases… Our 2026 Prediction: You can expect to see fewer sprawling AAA experiences, reduced publisher risk, and a steady flow of tighter, smaller-scope games.

findings.title: ChatGPT could become the top-grossing mobile app (IAP revenue) worldwide by Q4 2026
findings.description: Forecasts show ChatGPT already at #2 for in-app purchase revenue by Q3 2025, with momentum that could see it overtake TikTok to claim the #1 spot by the end of 2026.

evidence.quote: Bonus Prediction: ChatGPT Will Become the Top App by IAP Revenue by the End of 2026… ChatGPT was already the #2 app globally by IAP revenue.
